headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: PER (10)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Austrian Grand Prix from pole position, 5.2s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Sergio Perez completing the podium.
Sergio Perez made the biggest climb, from P15 to P3.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.

The stewards penalised HAM (5 second time penalty), TSU (5 second time penalty), OCO (5 second time penalty), SAI (5 second time penalty), ALB (5 second time penalty), DEV (5 second time penalty), GAS (5 second time penalty), TSU (10 second time penalty), SAR (5 second time penalty) and MAG (5 second time penalty).
There were 63 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 4 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 81 points over Sergio Perez.
